stories.title: Toggle the dial and see the current level
stories.user_value: As the operator I can set off/on/1-5 and check status so I control how simply Claude explains things.

stories.title: The level sticks every turn and survives /clear
stories.user_value: As the operator I don't have to re-ask each turn; the level persists reliably.

stories.title: Nothing important gets corrupted
stories.user_value: As a finance user I trust exact numbers, caveats, code, and legal terms survive at any level.

stories.title: The output actually reads at the chosen level
stories.user_value: As the operator the answer is genuinely first-grade / 5th-grade / etc. when I ask for it.

stories.title: Escape hatches, discoverability, and clean rollout
stories.user_value: As the operator I can get one raw answer without disabling the session, and always know the state.
